On launch, Vectorae enrolls the strategy's `verified` leads that have the address the first step needs: an email address for an email first step, a LinkedIn profile for a LinkedIn first step, and a phone number for a WhatsApp (or AI call) first step.

It starts from published industry patterns, which are starting assumptions, not promises: business email Tuesday to Thursday 09:00 to 11:00; LinkedIn weekday mornings and lunchtime; WhatsApp late morning or mid-afternoon.

It can only be turned on while **daily send approval** is on for every channel it uses (email, LinkedIn and WhatsApp), and if daily send approval is turned off later, Autopilot pauses, tells you, and its messages wait until approval is back.

If a channel is not ready (for example Gmail is not connected, no LinkedIn account is connected, or your plan does not include it), Autopilot starts the channels that are ready, tells you by email and notification what to connect, and starts the waiting channel by itself once it is ready.
LinkedIn and WhatsApp steps in between are skipped over; the email replies to the last email.

When a call goes through ElevenLabs (used when Vapi is not set up or refuses the call), Vectorae first checks that the ElevenLabs agent lets Vectorae set the call's opening line and script (and the voice, for a call in your own voice).
Can the AI call people in my own voice?
Yes, if your administrator has turned on AI calling and voice cloning (both are off by default).
In **Settings**, **Voice**, under **Your voice on calls**, you sign a written consent that the recordings are of your own voice, then upload recordings (or record them in the browser).
They are sent straight to ElevenLabs, which creates a Professional Voice Clone; Vectorae does not keep the recordings.
ElevenLabs then asks you to read a short text aloud to prove the voice is yours, and trains the voice, which can take hours.
When it is ready you can hear the opening line and turn on **Use my voice for AI calls**.
Your voice sounds like you, but the assistant never pretends to be you or a human.

Which plans include LinkedIn?
LinkedIn steps in sequences** are part of the plan's channel list.
The Growth, Scale, Pay per meeting, Pro and Enterprise plans include the LinkedIn channel.
If your plan does not include it, creating a sequence with a LinkedIn step is refused with an upgrade message.

For sequences enrolled from 12 October 2026 on, LinkedIn steps scheduled before a downgrade are held when they come due, not sent, and show the reason on the lead and on the Campaigns page; they are released automatically within about 30 minutes once your plan includes LinkedIn again.
The Network page** (your private LinkedIn network) is included with Growth, Scale, Pro and Enterprise.
It is **not** included with Pay per meeting, even though that plan includes the LinkedIn channel.
Has LinkedIn sending been verified against the live service?
Vectorae talks to LinkedIn through a third-party service called Unipile.
Until that check is done, treat LinkedIn sending as not yet verified against the live service.
Your Vectorae administrator must also set up Unipile (Admin > Integrations > Unipile) before any LinkedIn sending can work.
If it is not set up, LinkedIn steps fail with the reason "LinkedIn is not configured".
How do I connect my LinkedIn account?
Go to **Settings**, open the **Integrations** tab, and find the **LinkedIn** card.
You are sent to Unipile's hosted sign-in page and sign in to LinkedIn there.
